summary: Every read-only novel command's --dry-run path must honor --json/--agent/piped-stdout by emitting a JSON envelope instead of unconditional prose, matching the emitDryRunShortCircuit helper the write commands in forkable_orders.go already use.
reason: All 7 novel read commands (served-history, preference-drift, why-picked, spend-trend, allowance-burn, upcoming-digest, venue-rotation) independently hand-rolled an unconditional fmt.Fprintln on the dry-run path, so `<command> --dry-run --json` (or --agent, or piped stdout) printed prose instead of valid JSON — breaking the agent contract AGENTS.md documents (`<command> --dry-run --agent` before an unfamiliar command) and dogfood's json_fidelity check. emitDryRunShortCircuit already existed in forkable_orders.go as a general-purpose helper (not write-command-specific) and was simply unused by the read commands; retrofitting it is a one-line-per-file swap that is byte-identical on the human/terminal prose path and only changes behavior on the previously-broken machine-output path.
validated_outcome: go build clean across all 7 files (fmt import still used elsewhere in each); manual verification that `venue-rotation --dry-run --json` now emits {"dry_run":true,"action":"..."} instead of prose.
